name: Las Vegas Strip

demography.source: US Census Bureau ACS 2024 1-year, tables B01001 and B18101
demography.caveat: Residents of Clark County. At any given hour the Strip is mostly visitors, whose age structure is very different — use the 'Strip visitors' population mix for that.
demography.note: County figures applied to a district; zone populations remain modelled.
